description: This file defines the TimesheetDao class in the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the OrangeHRM	ime ank older, which handles database interactions related to timesheets, timesheet items, logs, and reports within the Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, updating, deleting, and reporting on timesheet data.

classes.name: TimesheetDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class handling all database operations related to timesheets, timesheet items, logs, and reporting for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

methods.name: getTimesheetById
methods.description: Retrieve a Timesheet entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveTimesheet
methods.description: Save or update a Timesheet entity.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemByTimesheetIdAndTimesheetItemId
methods.description: Retrieve a TimesheetItem by timesheet ID and item ID.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsByTimesheetId
methods.description: Fetch all TimesheetItems associated with a specific timesheet.

methods.name: saveTimesheetItem
methods.description: Persist a new or existing TimesheetItem.

methods.name: saveTimesheetActionLog
methods.description: Persist a TimesheetActionLog entry.

methods.name: hasTimesheetForStartDate
methods.description: Check if a timesheet exists for an employee on a specific start date.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogs
methods.description: Retrieve logs associated with a specific timesheet, filtered by search parameters.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogsPaginator
methods.description: Get a paginator object for timesheet action logs with applied filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogsCount
methods.description: Count the number of logs for a specific timesheet matching search filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetByStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Retrieve timesheets within a specified date range and other filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetCount
methods.description: Count timesheets based on filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteTimesheetRows
methods.description: Delete specified project/activity rows from a timesheet.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTimesheetItems
methods.description: Batch save or update a list of timesheet items.

methods.name: isDuplicateTimesheetItem
methods.description: Check if a timesheet item with specific project/activity already exists.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetList
methods.description: Retrieve timesheet list for an employee with filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetPaginator
methods.description: Get a paginator for employee timesheet list with filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetListCount
methods.description: Count timesheet entries for an employee.

methods.name: getDefaultTimesheet
methods.description: Get the default timesheet for an employee based on parameters.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Retrieve timesheet items for employee report with filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsCountForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Count timesheet items for employee report.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Calculate total duration for employee report based on filters.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemByProjectIdAndTimesheetIdAndActivityIdAndDate
methods.description: Retrieve a specific timesheet item based on project, activity, date, and timesheet.
